notablePrerequisites: Empowered Autogenerator has at least three charge counters on it.
description:
Activate Empowered Autogenerator by tapping it, putting a charge counter on it and adding at least {U}{U}{U}{U}.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping Basalt Monolith and Soliton, untapping Empowered Autogenerator.
Activate Soliton by paying {U}, untapping it.
Activate Basalt Monolith's second ability by paying {3}, untapping it.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may use it to activate Basalt Monolith's other abilities and/or untap any artifact(s) you control.
